description: Extract structured data from a set of pages with an LLM, guided by a prompt and an optional JSON schema.

allowExternalLinks.description: When true, allow extraction to follow links to external domains from the given pages.

enableWebSearch.description: When true, allow web search to supplement the extraction from the given URLs.

prompt.description: Optional prompt guiding the LLM extraction of structured data from the pages.

schema.description: Optional JSON schema describing the shape of the structured data to extract.

urls.description: URLs of the pages to extract structured data from.

name: firecrawl_extract
